budget.derivation: non-P.V path ends at HUB_PUB 1326 (+49 finalize/emit = 1377 floor at T=8192); P.V must end by ~1700 (1.0x). P.V cannot start before the last EP e group is visible (~EXP+zwalk+188 = 849 at T=8192); then 32 serial chain steps per chain (s_pv=256) at a round of 128/W cycles + tail. W=4/pair (8 rows/cycle): 32x32+tail ~1,200 -> ~2,100 service = 1.19x with link: misses. W=8/pair (16 rows/cycle): 528+129 -> 1,555: meets. W=16 violates the 11-edge chain loop (round 8). QK (32 rows/cycle, 256 cycles) and softmax/hub (EXP pass 8 e/cycle/stack, Z/recip tree) already fit and are unchanged.
